overall_summary: Analysis of the performance data reveals clear outliers in husband-wife relationship topics ('Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' with 1770 views and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' with 1679 views), significantly outperforming general shayari or family relationship videos. General emotional and daily life reflections perform moderately, while overly poetic or niche shayari struggles.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on post-marriage realities and spousal understanding achieved nearly 1,700+ views, compared to an average of under 300 for others.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on husband-wife emotional dynamics and unspoken marital friction.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles framed as a direct question about relationship realities ('Shaadi Ke Baad...', 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala...') generated higher engagement.
winning_patterns.action: Use curious, relatable conversational questions as titles and hooks.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' received very low traction (21 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, abstract, or overly bitter poetic lines; stay grounded in everyday observable scenarios.
